item.title: This Day in New Jersey History — November 6: Rutgers and Princeton play the first intercollegiate football game
item.description: On November 6, 1869, Rutgers defeated Princeton 6–4 in New Brunswick in what is recognized as the first intercollegiate football game in the United States. Source: Middlesex County historical research
